title: Get Started
text: PhyloCactus framework integrates sequence acquisition, data curation, evolutionary modeling, tree inference, temporal calibration, metadata enrichment, topological validation single workflow. Specifically, package automates retrieval homologous DNA sequences GenBank via phylotaR, infers positional homology using MAFFT, applies objective quality control masking DECIPHER. Following taxonomic nomenclature standardization supermatrix concatenation, PhyloCactus evaluates nucleotide substitution models using ModelTest-NG, infers maximum-likelihood phylogenies RAxML-NG, estimates divergence times penalized likelihood using treePL. Finally, suite integrates macroevolutionary conservation categories IUCN Red List (rredlist), renders publication-ready tree visualizations, quantifies comparative topological agreement across alternative phylogenetic hypotheses.

text: Constructing reliable multilocus molecular sequence matrices directly public repositories GenBank presents fundamental computational challenge systematic biology. Sequence records deposited across decades frequently exhibit inconsistent locus annotations, duplicated accessions, unvouchered identifications, orthographic variants, massive nomenclatural synonymies. Transforming uncurated records high-quality phylogenetic matrices requires intensive manual curation, taxonomic reconciliation authoritative botanical checklists, rigorous alignment quality control. computational problem becomes exponentially complex targeting plant lineages intricate evolutionary histories. Clades characterized recent explosive adaptive radiations, low plastid sequence divergence, incomplete lineage sorting (ILS), ancient reticulate evolution amplify risk misidentifying orthology, accumulating systematic alignment noise, producing biased topological reconstructions. family Cactaceae serves prime empirical exemplar combined computational biological hurdles. Comprising one largest succulent plant radiations Neotropics (Arakaki et al. 2011; Hernández-Hernández et al. 2014; Guerrero et al. 2019), cactus phylogenetics requires extensive data curation resolve persistent gene tree discordance handle heterogeneous molecular datasets. PhyloCactus developed transform complex data preparation analytical process fully automated, transparent, reproducible R workflow. Rather relying manual ad hoc scripts, PhyloCactus orchestrates established bioinformatics software standardized 4-stage pipeline. package automates orthology-based sequence retrieval (phylotaR), alignment positional homology (MAFFT), objective quality control masking (DECIPHER), mutational saturation screening, substitution model evaluation (ModelTest-NG), constrained maximum-likelihood topology inference (RAxML-NG), Transfer Bootstrap Expectation support mapping (TBE), penalized likelihood chronogram estimation (treePL), IUCN Red List metadata enrichment (rredlist), multispecies coalescent tree-space validation (ASTRAL-III).

title: Phylogenetic Inference and Divergence Time Estimation Pipeline for Cactaceae
text: PhyloCactus pipeline organized four analytical stages comprising thirteen interoperable modules: Stage 1: Data Assembly Preparation (Modules 1 6) Retrieves orthologous sequence clusters using similarity-based clustering via phylotaR, bypassing GenBank annotation errors. Establishes positional homology MAFFT, applies objective quality control masking DECIPHER, screens locus alignments mutational saturation slope erosion (Xia test), reconciles species nomenclature Caryophyllales.org checklist (CactaceaeFullList_accepted.csv; Korotkova et al. 2021), executes joint alignment ingroup (Cactaceae) outgroup (Portulaca, Anacampseros, Talinopsis, Grahamia) markers, concatenates locus alignments partitioned supermatrices explicit coordinate boundaries. Stage 2: Phylogenetic Inference Dating (Modules 7 10) Evaluates partition-specific nucleotide substitution models using ModelTest-NG corrected Akaike Information Criteria (AICc) control mutational rate heterogeneity mitigate Long-Branch Attraction (LBA). Infers maximum-likelihood topologies using RAxML-NG topological constraint scaffolds (cactus_constraints.csv) enforcing higher-level clade monophyly (Cactoideae, Opuntioideae, Leuenbergeria, Pereskia). Maps clade support via Transfer Bootstrap Expectation (TBE) handle missing data, generates topologically constrained temporal bootstrap alignments, estimates ultrametric chronograms using penalized likelihood treePL guided secondary calibration boundaries (calibrations_bounds.csv). Stage 3: Visualization Metadata Integration (Modules 11 12) Enriches phylogenetic framework species-level conservation attributes retrieved automatically IUCN Red List database via rredlist. Collapses weakly supported internal nodes (TBE < 0.70) soft politomies prevent -interpreting unresolved rapid radiation nodes, renders publication-ready phylogenetic figures, chronograms, conservation cadastres using ggplot2. Stage 4: Validation Sub-tree Comparisons (Module 13) Quantifies topological congruence focal supermatrix tree external published backbones (e.g., Amaral et al. 2022; Thompson et al. 2024; de Vos et al. 2025) using Robinson-Foulds distances multidimensional scaling (MDS) tree-space projections (validate_phylogenies). Infers summary species trees using ASTRAL-III multispecies coalescent theory evaluate biological gene tree discordance driven incomplete lineage sorting.
